bio: Bianca Rizzo represents the remarkable evolution from survivor to artist, her journey from market-stall merchant to playwright having forged her into Venice's most authentic dramatic voice. Her observant nature has been honed by necessity into an almost supernatural ability to read human motivation, allowing her to craft characters and dialogue that feel startlingly real because they are drawn from life rather than imagination.
